duas.a: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
duas.e: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: A'oodhu billaahi minash shaytaanir rajeem. Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwal hayyul qayyoomu, laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun walaa nawmun lahu maa fees samaawaati wamaa feel ardi man dhaa alladhee yashfa'u 'indahu illaa bi idhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum walaa yuheetoona bishay'in min 'ilmihi illaa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kursiyyuhus samaawaati wal arda walaa ya'ooduhu hifzuhumaa wahuwal 'aliyyul 'azeemu

duas.a: (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾.) (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾.) (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾)
duas.e: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One, Allāh, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent." Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies." Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind".
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: qul huwa l-lahu aḥadun al-lahu l-ṣamadu lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥadun qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-falaqi min sharri mā khalaqa wamin sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqaba wamin sharri l-nafāthāti fī l-ʿuqadi wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasada qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-nāsi maliki l-nāsi ilāhi l-nāsi min sharri l-waswāsi l-khanāsi alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri l-nāsi mina l-jinati wal-nāsi

duas.a: ((أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ)). [ وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه] [وإذا أمسى قال: رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها.]
duas.e: ‘We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allaah, belongs all sovereignty , and all praise is for Allaah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, alone, without any partner, to Him belong all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it . My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.’
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا ، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم بك أمسينا، وبك أصبحنا، وبك نحيا، وبك نموت، وإليك المصير.]
duas.e: (O Allah, by your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection.)[In the evening:](O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.)
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: (Allahumma bika asbahna wabika amsayna, wabika nahya ,wabika namootu wa-ilaykan-nushoor.)[In the evening:] (Allahumma bika amsayna, wabika asbahna, wabika nahya wabika namootu wa-ilaykal-maseer.)

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.e: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity worthy of worship except You. You created me, and I am Your servant. I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Allaahumma anta Rabbee laa ilaaha illaa anta, khalaqtanee wa anaa 'abduka, wa anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wawa'dika mastata'tu, a'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana'tu, aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa aboo'u bidhanbee faghfir lee fa innahu laa yaghfirudh dhunooba illaa ant

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ)) (أربعَ مَرَّاتٍ).[ وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم إني أمسيت...]
duas.e: (O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angles, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.) (four times in the morning & evening)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsaytu) instead of (asbahtu).)
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Allaahumma innee asbahtu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu hamalata 'arshika, wamalaa'ikataka, wajamee'a khalqika, annaka anta allaahu laa ilaaha illaa anta wahdaka laa shareeka lak, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka warasooluk

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم ما أمسى بي...]
duas.e: (O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon, is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.)(…whoever says this in the morning has indeed offered his day’s thanks and whoever says this in the evening has indeed offered his night’s thanks.)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsa) instead of (asbaha).)
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: (Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.)

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.e: O Allah, protect my body (from illness and from what I do not want). O Allah, protect my hearing (from illness and disobedience or from what I do not want). O Allah, protect my sight, there is no deity worthy of worship except You. O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, there is no deity worthy of worship except You.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Allaahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, allaahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, allaahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, laa ilaaha illaa anta. Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal kufri wal faqri, wa a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil qabri, laa ilaaha illaa anta

duas.a: ((حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ)) (سَبْعَ مَرّاتٍ).
duas.e: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.’ (Recite seven times in Arabic.)
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 5083 (Abu al-Darda’ said:)
duas.t: Hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu, wahuwa rabbul 'arshil 'azeem

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي)).
duas.e: O Allah, indeed I ask You for well-being and safety in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, indeed I ask You for well-being and safety in my religion, my world, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my flaws (faults and things that are not appropriate for others to see) and calm me from fear. O Allah, protect me from the front, behind, right, left and above me. I seek refuge in Your greatness, so that I am not snatched from below me (by snakes or swallowed by the earth, etc., which would cause me to fall).
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Allaahumma innee as'alukal 'afwa wal 'aafiyata feed dunyaa wal aakhirah. Allaahumma innee as'alukal 'afwa wal 'aafiyata fee deenee wadunyaaya wa ahlee wamaalee. Allaahummastur 'awraatee, wa aamin raw'aatee. Allaahummahfaznee min bayni yadayya, wamin khalfee, wa'an yameenee, wa'an shimaalee, wamin fawqee, wa a'oodhu bi'azamatika an ughtaala min tahtee

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ)).
duas.e: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of all things and their Sovereign. I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, Satan and his soldiers (temptations to commit shirk against Allah), and I (seek refuge in You) from committing evil against myself or dragging it to a Muslim.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Allaahumma 'aalimal ghaybi wash shahaadati, faatiras samaawaati wal ardi, rabba kulli shay'in wamaleekahu, ashhadu an laa ilaaha illaa anta, a'oodhu bika min sharri nafsee, wamin sharrish shaytaani washarakihi, wa an aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo'an, aw ajurrahu ilaa muslim

duas.a: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.e: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth or the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Bismillaahi alladhee laa yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un feel ardi walaa fees samaa'i wahuwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

duas.a: ((رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيّاً)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.e: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, as my Prophet.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Radeetu billaahi rabban, wabil islaami deenan, wabi Muhammadin nabiyyan

duas.a: ((يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ)).
duas.e: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help, rectify all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom, birahmatika astagheethu, aslih lee sha'niya kullahu walaa takilnee ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayn

duas.a: ((أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ:فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه ربّ العالمين اللَّهم إني أسألك خير هذه الليلة: فتحها، ونصرها، ونورها، وبركتها، وهداها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما فيها، وشر ما بعدها.]
duas.e: (We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.)[For the evening, the supplication is read as follows:](We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it.)
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: (Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-yawm, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.)[For the evening, the supplication is read as follows: ](Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathihil-laylah, fat-haha, wanasraha, wanooraha, wabarakataha, wahudaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feeha washarri ma baAAdaha.)

duas.a: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ)) (مائة مرَّةٍ).
duas.e: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Subhaanallaahi wabihamdih

duas.a: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)) (عشرَ مرَّات) ، أَوْ (مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ).
duas.e: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Laa ilaaha illallaahu, wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

duas.a: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)) (مائةَ مرَّةٍ إذا أصبحَ).
duas.e: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Laa ilaaha illallaahu, wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

duas.a: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أصبحَ).
duas.e: Glory be to Allah, as many as His creations, Glory be to Allah as much as His pleasure, Glory be to Allah as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His written words.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Subhaanallaahi wabihamdihi: 'adada khalqihi, waridaa nafsihi, wazinata 'arshihi, wamidaada kalimaatih

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً)) (إذا أصبحَ).
duas.e: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Allaahumma innee as'aluka 'ilman naafi'an, warizqan tayyiban, wa'amalan mutaqabbalan

duas.a: ((أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ)) (مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ).
duas.e: I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: Astaghfirullaaha wa atoobu ilayh

duas.a: ((أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أمسى).
duas.e: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.t: A'oodhu bikalimaati allaahit taammaati min sharri maa khalaq

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ)) (عشرَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.e: ‘O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.’ [ten times]
duas.c: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Allaahumma salli wasallim 'alaa nabiyyinaa Muhammad

duas.a: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْـــــــــــدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
duas.e: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.t: allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwal hayyul qayyoomu laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun walaa nawmun lahu maa fees samaawaati wamaa feel ardi man dhaa alladhee yashfa'u 'indahu illaa bi idhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum walaa yuheetoona bishay'in min 'ilmihi illaa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kursiyyuhus samaawaati wal arda walaa ya'ooduhu hifzuhumaa wahuwal 'aliyyul 'azeemu

duas.a: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾.
duas.e: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allāh and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination." Allāh does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.t: aamanar rasoolu bimaa unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal mu'minoona kullun aamana billaahi wamalaa'ikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi laa nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi waqaaloo sami'naa wa ata'naa ghufraanaka rabbanaa wa ilaykal maseeru laa yukallifu allaahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa lahaa maa kasabat wa'alayhaa maa iktasabat rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa in naseenaa aw akhta'naa rabbanaa walaa tahmil 'alaynaa isran kamaa hamaltahu 'alaa alladheena min qablinaa rabbanaa walaa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bihi wa u'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alaal qawmil kaafireena

duas.a: ((بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ)).
duas.e: (In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.)
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.s: Jami at-Tirmidhi 3485 (Abu Hurairah (ra) narrated that :)
duas.t: Bismika Rabbee wada'tu janbee, wabika arfa'uh, fa in amsakta nafsee farhamhaa, wa in arsaltahaa fahfazhaa, bimaa tahfazu bihi 'ibaadakas saaliheen

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take it’s life, to You belongs it’s life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take it’s life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant me good health.)
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Allaahumma innaka khalaqta nafsee wa anta tawaffaahaa, laka mamaatuhaa wamahyaahaa, in ahyaytahaa fahfazhaa, wa in amattahaa faghfir lahaa. Allaahumma innee as'alukal 'aafiyah

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.)
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 5047 (Narrated Hafsah, Ummul Mu'minin:)
duas.t: Allaahumma qinee 'adhaabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibaadak

duas.a: ((بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا)).
duas.e: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.t: Bismika allaahumma amootu wa ahyaa

duas.a: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (أربعاً وثلاثينَ))).
duas.e: (How Perfect Allah is. (thirty-three times) All praise is for Allah.(thirty-three times) Allah is the greatest.(thirty-four times))
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Subhaanallaah. Wal hamdu lillaah. Wallaahu akbar

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock (i.e. You have total mastery over). O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You.You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You.Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.)(Tawrah: The book revealed to Moosa u.)(Injeel: The book revealed to Easa u.)(Furqan: One of the many names of the Quran, means: The Criterion which distinguishes between truth and falsehood.)(Aththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.)
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Allaahumma Rabbas samaawaatis sab'i wa Rabbal ard, wa Rabbal 'arshil 'azeem, Rabbanaa wa Rabba kulli shay, faaliqal habbi wan nawaa, wamunzilat Tawraati wal Injeeli wal Furqaan, a'oodhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in anta aakhidhun binaasiyatih. Allaahumma antal Awwalu falaysa qablaka shay, wa antal Aakhiru falaysa ba'daka shay, wa antaz Zaahiru falaysa fawqaka shay, wa antal Baatinu falaysa doonaka shay, iqdi 'annad dayna wa aghninaa minal faqr

duas.a: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ)).
duas.e: (All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.)
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Alhamdu lillaahi alladhee at'amanaa wasaqaanaa, wakafaanaa, wa aawaanaa, fakam mimman laa kaafiya lahu walaa mu'wiya

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ)).
duas.e: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of all things and their Sovereign. I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, Satan and his soldiers (temptations to commit shirk against Allah), and I (seek refuge in You) from committing evil against myself or dragging it to a Muslim.
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.t: Allaahumma 'aalimal ghaybi wash shahaadati, faatiras samaawaati wal ardi, rabba kulli shay'in wamaleekahu, ashhadu an laa ilaaha illaa anta, a'oodhu bika min sharri nafsee, wamin sharrish shaytaani washirkihi, wa an aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo'an, aw ajurrahu ilaa muslim

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You.Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.)(If you then die, you will die upon the fitrah.)(fitrah: the religion of Islam, the way of Ibraheem u.)
duas.c: What to say before sleeping
duas.s: Sahih al-Bukhari 6076 (Narrated Al-Bara bin `Azib:)
duas.t: Allaahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wafawwadtu amree ilayk, wawajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa alja'tu zahree ilayk, raghbatan warahbatan ilayk, laa malja'a walaa manjaa minka illaa ilayk, aamantu bikitaabika alladhee anzalt, wabinabiyyika alladhee arsalt

duas.a: (.الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ )
duas.e: All praise is for Allah who gives us life after He has caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
duas.c: supplications for when you wake up
duas.t: Alhamdu lillaahi alladhee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa, wa ilayhin nushoor

duas.a: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي
duas.e: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without associate, to Him belongs sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable. How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme.O my Lord forgive me)
duas.c: supplications for when you wake up
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer. Subhaanallaahi, wal hamdu lillaahi, walaa ilaaha illallaahu, wallaahu akbar, walaa hawla walaa quwwata illaa billaahil 'aliyyil 'azeem. Rabbighfir lee

duas.a: ( الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ )
duas.e: (All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and has allowed me to remember Him.)
duas.c: supplications for when you wake up
duas.s: Jami at-Tirmidhi 3485 (Abu Hurairah (ra) narrated that :)
duas.t: Alhamdu lillaahi alladhee 'aafaanee fee jasadee, waradda 'alayya roohee, wa adhina lee bidhikrih

duas.a: ﴿ إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ * الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ* رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ* رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ* رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ* فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ * لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ * مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ * لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ * وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ*يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴾
duas.e: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding - Who remember Allāh while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], "Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers. Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die among the righteous. Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise." And their Lord responded to them, "Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allāh, and Allāh has with Him the best reward." Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land. [It is but] a small enjoyment; then their [final] refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place. But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allāh. And that which is with Allāh is best for the righteous. And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allāh and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, [being] humbly submissive to Allāh. They do not exchange the verses of Allāh for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allāh is swift in account. O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allāh that you may be successful.
duas.c: supplications for when you wake up
duas.t: inna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri laāyātin li-ulī l-albābi alladhīna yadhkurūna l-laha qiyāman waquʿūdan waʿalā junūbihim wayatafakkarūna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan sub'ḥānaka faqinā ʿadhāba l-nāri rabbanā innaka man tud'khili l-nāra faqad akhzaytahu wamā lilẓẓālimīna min anṣārin rabbanā innanā samiʿ'nā munādiyan yunādī lil'īmāni an āminū birabbikum faāmannā rabbanā fa-igh'fir lanā dhunūbanā wakaffir ʿannā sayyiātinā watawaffanā maʿa l-abrāri rabbanā waātinā mā waʿadttanā ʿalā rusulika walā tukh'zinā yawma l-qiyāmati innaka lā tukh'lifu l-mīʿāda fa-is'tajāba lahum rabbuhum annī lā uḍīʿu ʿamala ʿāmilin minkum min dhakarin aw unthā baʿḍukum min baʿḍin fa-alladhīna hājarū wa-ukh'rijū min diyārihim waūdhū fī sabīlī waqātalū waqutilū la-ukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiātihim wala-ud'khilannahum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru thawāban min ʿindi l-lahi wal-lahu ʿindahu ḥus'nu l-thawābi lā yaghurrannaka taqallubu alladhīna kafarū fī l-bilādi matāʿun qalīlun thumma mawāhum jahannamu wabi'sa l-mihādu lākini alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā nuzulan min ʿindi l-lahi wamā ʿinda l-lahi khayrun lil'abrāri wa-inna min ahli l-kitābi laman yu'minu bil-lahi wamā unzila ilaykum wamā unzila ilayhim khāshiʿīna lillahi lā yashtarūna biāyāti l-lahi thamanan qalīlan ulāika lahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū iṣ'birū waṣābirū warābiṭū wa-ittaqū l-laha laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna

duas.a: ([بِسْمِ اللَّهِ] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث).
duas.e: ((In the name of Allah). O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.)
duas.c: Invocation for entering the restroom
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: [Bismillaah] Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal khubthi wal khabaa'ith

duas.a: (غُفْرَانَكَ).
duas.e: I ask for Your forgiveness (O Allah).
duas.c: Invocation for leaving the restroom
duas.t: Ghufraanak

duas.a: (أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ..).
duas.e: (I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.)
duas.c: What to say upon completing ablution
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 525 (Sa’d b. Abi Waqqas reported the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) as saying :)
duas.t: Ashhadu an laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu warasooluh

duas.a: (اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ)
duas.e: (O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.)
duas.c: What to say upon completing ablution
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 353 ('Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:)
duas.t: Allaahummaj'alnee minat tawwaabeena waj'alnee minal mutatahhireen

duas.a: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَاَ حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ).
duas.e: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.
duas.c: What to say when leaving the home
duas.t: Bismillaah, tawakkaltu 'alaa allaah, walaa hawla walaa quwwata illaa billaah

duas.a: (اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ).
duas.e: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should stray or be led astray, slip or be tripped, wrong or be wronged, or act foolishly or have foolishness done to me.
duas.c: What to say when leaving the home
duas.t: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika an adilla, aw udalla, aw azilla, aw uzalla, aw azlima, aw uzlama, aw ajhala, aw yujhala 'alayya

duas.a: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا، ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ).
duas.e: (In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.)
duas.c: What to say when entering the home
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 5098 (Narrated AbuMalik Al-Ash'ari:)
duas.t: Bismillaahi walajnaa, wabismillaahi kharajnaa, wa'alaa allaahi rabbinaa tawakkalnaa

duas.a: ((يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُسْرَى)) وَيَقُولُ: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِك، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)).
duas.e: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil.
duas.c: Invocation for leaving the mosque
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Bismillaahi was salaatu was salaamu 'alaa rasoolillaah, allaahumma innee as'aluka min fadlik, allaahumma'simnee minash shaytaanir rajeem

duas.a: (الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا (الثَّوْبَ) وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّة...)
duas.e: Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.
duas.c: Invocation when getting dressed
duas.t: Alhamdu lillaahi alladhee kasaanee haadhaa (ath thawba) warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee walaa quwwah

duas.a: ( اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ).
duas.e: O Allah, to You is all praise. You have clothed me with this. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
duas.c: Invocation when putting on new clothes
duas.t: Allaahumma lakal hamdu anta kasawtaneehi, as'aluka min khayrihi wakhayri maa suni'a lah, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihi washarri maa suni'a lah

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْني مِنْ خَطَايَايَ، بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْماءِ وَالْبَرَدِ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You have distanced The East from The West, O Allah, purify me of my sins as a white robe is purified of filth, O Allah, cleanse me of my sins with snow, water, and ice.)
duas.c: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer
duas.s: Sunan an-Nasai 60 (It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:)
duas.t: Allaahumma baa'id baynee wabayna khataayaaya kamaa baa'adta baynal mashriqi wal maghrib, allaahumma naqqinee min khataayaaya kamaa yunaqqaath thawbul abyadu minad danas, allaahummaghsilnee min khataayaaya bith thalji wal maa'i wal barad

duas.a: ((سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)).
duas.e: (How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. Blessed be Your name, and lofty is Your position and none has the right to be worshipped except You.)
duas.c: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer
duas.s: Sunan an-Nasai 902 (It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed said:)
duas.t: Subhaanaka allaahumma wabihamdika, watabaarakasmuka, wata'aalaa jadduka, walaa ilaaha ghayruk

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ، وَمِيْكَائِيلَ، وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ. اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقيمٍ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel (great angles), Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Knower of the seen and the unseen. You are the arbitrator between Your servants in that which they have disputed. Guide me to the truth by Your leave, in that which they have differed, for verily You guide whom You will to a straight path.)
duas.c: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer
duas.s: Sahih Muslim 1703 ('Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf reported:)
duas.t: Allaahumma Rabba Jibraa'eela, wa Meekaa'eela, wa Israafeel, faatiras samaawaati wal ard, 'aalimal ghaybi wash shahaadah, anta tahkumu bayna 'ibaadika feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon. Ihdinee limaa ikhtulifa feehi minal haqqi bi idhnik, innaka tahdee man tashaa'u ilaa siraatin mustaqeem

duas.a: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي)).
duas.e: (How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.)
duas.c: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 746 ('Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:)
duas.t: Subhaanaka allaahumma rabbanaa wabihamdika, allaahummaghfir lee

duas.a: ((سُبُّوُحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ المَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ)).
duas.e: (Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).)
duas.c: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 747 ('Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:)
duas.t: Subboohun, Quddoosun, rabbul malaa'ikati war rooh

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي، وَبَصَرِي، وَمُخِّي، وَعَــــظْمِي، وَعَصَبِي، [وَمَا استَقَلَّتْ بِهِ قَدَمِي])).
duas.e: (O Allah, unto You I have bowed, and in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, sight, mind, bones, tendons and what my feet carry are humbled before You.)
duas.c: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Allaahumma laka raka'tu, wabika aamantu, walaka aslamtu, khasha'a laka sam'ee, wabasaree, wamukhkhee, wa'azmee, wa'asabee, [wamastaqallat bihi qadamee]

duas.a: ((سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ)).
duas.e: (How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.)
duas.c: Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)
duas.s: Sunan an-Nasai 1051 ('Asim bin Humaid said:)
duas.t: Subhaana dheel jabarooti, wal malakooti, wal kibriyaa'i, wal 'azamah

duas.a: ((سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ)).
duas.e: (May Allah answer he who praises Him.)(This supplication is to be made while rising.)
duas.c: Invocations for rising from the Ruki'
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 849 (‘Amir said:)
duas.t: Sami'allaahu liman hamidah

duas.a: ((رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْداً كَثيراً طَيِّباً مُبارَكاً فِيهِ)).
duas.e: (Our Lord, for You is all praise, an abundant beautiful blessed praise.)
duas.c: Invocations for rising from the Ruki'
duas.s: Sahih al-Bukhari 782 (Narrated Rifa`a bin Rafi` Az-Zuraqi:)
duas.t: Rabbanaa walakal hamdu, hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubaarakan feeh

duas.a: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي)).
duas.e: (How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord, and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.)
duas.c: Invocations during Sujood
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 746 ('Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:)
duas.t: Subhaanaka allaahumma rabbanaa wabihamdika, allaahummaghfir lee

duas.a: ((سُبوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ)).
duas.e: (Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).)
duas.c: Invocations during Sujood
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 747 ('Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:)
duas.t: Subboohun, Quddoosun, rabbul malaa'ikati war rooh

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسنُ الْخَالِقينَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and in You I have believed, and unto You I have submitted. My face has prostrated before He Who created it and fashioned it, and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.)
duas.c: Invocations during Sujood
duas.s: Sahih Muslim 1704 ('Ali b. Abu Talib reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up at night for prayer he would say:)
duas.t: Allaahumma laka sajadtu wabika aamantu, walaka aslamtu, sajada wajhiya lilladhee khalaqahu, wasawwarahu, washaqqa sam'ahu wabasarahu, tabaarakallaahu ahsanul khaaliqeen

duas.a: ((سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ)).
duas.e: (How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.)
duas.c: Invocations during Sujood
duas.s: Sunan an-Nasai 1051 ('Asim bin Humaid said:)
duas.t: Subhaana dheel jabarooti, wal malakooti, wal kibriyaa'i, wal 'azamah

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise, You are as You have praised Yourself.)
duas.c: Invocations during Sujood
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 751 ('Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:)
duas.t: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu biridaaka min sakhatika, wabimu'aafaatika min 'uqoobatika, wa a'oodhu bika minka, laa uhsee thanaa'an 'alayka, anta kamaa athnayta 'alaa nafsika

duas.a: ((رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي)).
duas.e: (My Lord forgive me, My Lord forgive me.)
duas.c: Invocations for sitting between two prostrations
duas.s:
Sunan Ibn Majah 631 (It was
narrated from Hudhaifah that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say
between
the two prostrations:)
duas.t: Rabbighfir lee, rabbighfir lee

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْراً، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْراً، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْراً، وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, record for me a reward for this (prostration), and remove from me a sin. Save it for me and accept it from me just as You had accepted it from Your servant Dawood.)
duas.c: Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an
duas.s: Jami at-Tirmidhi 3508 (Al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid said:)
duas.t: Allaahummaktub lee bihaa 'indaka ajran, wada' 'annee bihaa wizran, waj'alhaa lee 'indaka dhukhran, wataqabbalhaa minnee kamaa taqabbaltahaa min 'abdika Daawood

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْواجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibraheem, and send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty.)
duas.c: How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud
duas.s: Sahih Muslim 813 (Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi reported:)
duas.t: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammadin wa'alaa azwaajihi wadhurriyyatihi, kamaa sallayta 'alaa aali Ibraaheem. Wabaarik 'alaa Muhammadin wa'alaa azwaajihi wadhurriyyatihi, kamaa baarakta 'alaa aali Ibraaheem. Innaka Hameedun Majeed

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I take refuge in You from the temptation and trial of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of life and death. O Allah, I take refuge in You from sin and debt.)
duas.c: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 880 (Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin:)
duas.t: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil qabri, wa a'oodhu bika min fitnatil maseehid dajjaali, wa a'oodhu bika min fitnatil mahyaa wal mamaati. Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal ma'thami wal maghram

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.e: O Allah, forgive me for those sins which have come to pass as well as those which shall come to pass, and those I have committed in secret as well as those I have made public, and where I have exceeded all bounds as well as those things about which You are more knowledgeable. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.c: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 745 ('Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:)
duas.t: Allaahummaghfir lee maa qaddamtu, wamaa akhkhartu, wamaa asrartu, wamaa a'lantu, wamaa asraftu, wamaa anta a'lamu bihi minnee. Antal Muqaddimu wa antal Mu'akhkhiru, laa ilaaha illaa ant

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبادَتِكَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of manners.)
duas.c: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 743 (Mu'adh (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:)
duas.t: Allaahumma a'innee 'alaa dhikrika, washukrika, wahusni 'ibaadatik

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, I ask You to grant me Paradise and I take refuge in You from the Fire.)
duas.c: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 792 (Narrated Some Companions of the Prophet:)
duas.t: Allaahumma innee as'alukal jannata wa a'oodhu bika minan naar

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلقِ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْغِنَى وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيماً لاَ يَنْفَدُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ، وَأَسْــــأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقائِكَ فِي غَيرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ، وَلاَ فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَا بِزِينَةِ الإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know such life to be good for me and take me if You know death to be better for me. O Allah, make me fearful of You whether in secret or in public and I ask You to make me true in speech, in times of pleasure and anger.I ask you to make me moderate in times of wealth and poverty and I ask You for everlasting bliss and joy which will never cease.I ask You to make me pleased with what You have decreed and for an easy life after death.I ask You for the sweetness of looking upon Your Face and a longing to encounter You in a manner which does not entail a calamity which will bring about harm nor a trial which will cause deviation. O Allah, beautify us with the adornment of faith and make us of those who guide and are rightly guided.)
duas.c: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Allaahumma bi'ilmikal ghayba waqudratika 'alaal khalqi ahyinee maa 'alimtal hayaata khayran lee, watawaffanee idhaa 'alimtal wafaata khayran lee. Allaahumma innee as'aluka khashyataka feel ghaybi wash shahaadah, wa as'aluka kalimatal haqqi feer ridaa wal ghadab, wa as'alukal qasda feel ghinaa wal faqr, wa as'aluka na'eeman laa yanfad, wa as'aluka qurrata 'aynin laa tanqati', wa as'alukar ridaa ba'dal qadaa, wa as'aluka bardal 'ayshi ba'dal mawt, wa as'aluka ladhdhatan nazari ilaa wajhik, wash shawqa ilaa liqaa'ika fee ghayri darraa'a mudirrah, walaa fitnatin mudillah. Allaahumma zayyinnaa bizeenatil eemaan, waj'alnaa hudaatan muhtadeen

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، الْمَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner. You are the Benefactor. O Originator of the heavens and the Earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, verily I ask You for Paradise and I take refuge with You from the Fire.)
duas.c: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Allaahumma innee as'aluka bi anna lakal hamda, laa ilaaha illaa anta wahdaka laa shareeka lak, al Mannaan, yaa Badee'as samaawaati wal ard, yaa Dhaal jalaali wal ikraam, yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom, innee as'alukal jannata wa a'oodhu bika minan naar

duas.a: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ [ثلاثاً]، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ)).
duas.e: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. O Allah, there is no preventer of what You give, and no giver of what You withhold, and wealth and honor do not benefit their possessor (except faith and righteous deeds that save from punishment). Only from You is wealth and honor.
duas.c: What to say after completing the prayer
duas.t: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer. Allaahumma laa maani'a limaa a'tayta, walaa mu'tiya limaa mana'ta, walaa yanfa'u dhaal jaddi minkal jadd

duas.a: ((لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ, لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الكَافِرُونَ)).
duas.e: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. There is no power and no strength except by Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and we do not worship except Him. To Him belongs all favor, grace, and good praise. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, making our religion sincerely for Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
duas.c: What to say after completing the prayer
duas.t: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer. Laa hawla walaa quwwata illaa billaah, laa ilaaha illallaah, walaa na'budu illaa iyyaah, lahun ni'matu walahul fadlu walahuth thanaa'ul hasan, laa ilaaha illallaahu mukhliseena lahud deena walaw karihal kaafiroon

duas.a: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)).
duas.e: (How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the greatest.(thirty-three times) (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.))
duas.c: What to say after completing the prayer
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Subhaanallaahi, wal hamdu lillaahi, wallaahu akbar. Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً)) بَعْدَ السّلامِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الفَجْرِ.
duas.e: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
duas.c: What to say after completing the prayer
duas.t: Allaahumma innee as'aluka 'ilman naafi'an, warizqan tayyiban, wa'amalan mutaqabbalan

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُــــوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself.)
duas.c: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 751 ('Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:)
duas.t: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu biridaaka min sakhatika, wabimu'aafaatika min 'uqoobatika, wa a'oodhu bika minka, laa uhsee thanaa'an 'alayka, anta kamaa athnayta 'alaa nafsika

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)
duas.c: Invocations in times of worry and grief
duas.s: Sunan an-Nasai 5462 (It was narrated from Anas bin Malik, that :)
duas.t: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal hammi wal hazani, wal 'ajzi wal kasali, wal bukhli wal jubni, wadala'id dayni waghalabatir rijaal

duas.a: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ)).
duas.e: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.)
duas.c: Invocations for anguish
duas.s: Sahih al-Bukhari 6109 (Narrated Ibn `Abbas:)
duas.t: Laa ilaaha illallaahul 'azeemul haleem, laa ilaaha illallaahu rabbul 'arshil 'azeem, laa ilaaha illallaahu rabbus samaawaati warabbul ardi warabbul 'arshil kareem

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs.None has the right to be worshipped except You.)
duas.c: Invocations for anguish
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 5092 (Narrated AbuBakrah:)
duas.t: Allaahumma rahmataka arjoo, falaa takilnee ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayn, wa aslih lee sha'nee kullah, laa ilaaha illaa ant

duas.a: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ)).
duas.e: (None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.)
duas.c: Invocations for anguish
duas.s: Jami at-Tirmidhi 3589 (Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Sa`d narrated from his father, from Sa`d that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:)
duas.t: Laa ilaaha illaa anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz zaalimeen

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.)
duas.c: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler.
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 648 (Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:)
duas.t: Allaahumma innaa naj'aluka fee nuhoorihim, wana'oodhu bika min shuroorihim

duas.a: ((حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ)).
duas.e: (Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee (He is).)
duas.c: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler.
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 1293 (Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:)
duas.t: Hasbunallaahu wani'mal wakeel

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.)
duas.c: Invocation against an enemy
duas.s: Sahih Muslim 4411 (It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Abu Aufa that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed the tribes (who had marched upon Medina with a combined force in 5 H) and said:)
duas.t: Allaahumma munzilal kitaab, saree'al hisaab, ihzimil ahzaab, allaahummahzimhum wazalzilhum

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.)
duas.c: What to say if you fear people may harm you
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 1247 (Suhaib (May Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There lived a king before you and he had a court magician. As he (the magician) grew old, he said to the king:)
duas.t: Allaahummakfineehim bimaa shi'ta

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)
duas.c: Invocations for the setting of a debt
duas.s: Sunan an-Nasai 5462 (It was narrated from Anas bin Malik, that :)
duas.t: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal hammi wal hazani, wal 'ajzi wal kasali, wal bukhli wal jubni, wadala'id dayni waghalabatir rijaal

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً)).
duas.e: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You wish.
duas.c: Invocation for when you find something becoming difficult for you
duas.t: Allaahumma laa sahla illaa maa ja'altahu sahlan, wa anta taj'alul hazna idhaa shi'ta sahlan

duas.a: ((لاَ بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).
duas.e: (Never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification, if Allah wills.)
duas.c: Invocations for visiting the sick
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 228 (Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:)
duas.t: Laa ba'sa tahoorun in shaa'allaah

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى)).
duas.e: ‘O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions
duas.c: Invocations of the terminal ill
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 232 (`Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:)
duas.t: Allaahummaghfir lee, warhamnee, wa alhiqnee bir rafeeqil a'laa

duas.a: ((إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا)).
duas.e: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it with something better.
duas.c: Invocation for when tragedy strikes
duas.t: Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raaji'oon. Allaahumma'jurnee fee museebatee, wa akhlif lee khayran minhaa

duas.a: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ)).
duas.e: In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.
duas.c: Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 3214 (Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar:)
duas.t: Bismillaahi wa'alaa sunnati rasoolillaah

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ)).
duas.e: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him
duas.c: Invocation to be recited after burying the dead
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Allaahummaghfir lahu, allaahumma thabbithu

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْــــــأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا)).
duas.e: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this wind, and I seek refuge in You from its evil.
duas.c: Invocations for when the wind blows
duas.t: Allaahumma innee as'aluka khayrahaa, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa

duas.a: ((سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ)).
duas.e: (How perfect He is, (The One) Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.)
duas.c: Invocation for when it thunder
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Subhaana alladhee yusabbihur ra'du bihamdihi, wal malaa'ikatu min kheefatih

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.)
duas.c: Some invocations for rain
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 1170 (Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah:)
duas.t: Allaahummasqinaa ghaythan mugheethan maree'an maree'an, naafi'an ghayra daarr, 'aajilan ghayra aajil

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا)).
duas.e: (O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.)
duas.c: Some invocations for rain
duas.s: Sahih al-Bukhari 986 (Narrated Sharik:)
duas.t: Allaahumma aghithnaa, allaahumma aghithnaa, allaahumma aghithnaa

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً)).
duas.e: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.
duas.c: Invocation for when it rains
duas.t: Allaahumma sayyiban naafi'an

duas.a: ((مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ)).
duas.e: We have been given rain by the bounty and mercy of Allah.
duas.c: Supplication after it rains
duas.t: Mutirnaa bifadlillaahi warahmatih

duas.a: ((ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).
duas.e: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, Insha Allah.
duas.c: Invocations for breaking the fast
duas.t: Dhahabaz zama'u wabtallatil 'urooqu, wathabatal ajru in shaa'allaah

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي)).
duas.e: (O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.)
duas.c: Invocations for breaking the fast
duas.s:
Sunan Ibn Majah 1487 (It was
narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amr bin ‘As that the Messenger of
Allah (ﷺ) said:)
duas.t: Allaahumma innee as'aluka birahmatika allatee wasi'at kulla shay'in an taghfira lee

duas.a: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ)).
duas.e: All praise is to Allah who has fed me this and provided for me without any power or strength from me.
duas.c: Invocations after eating
duas.t: Alhamdu lillaahi alladhee at'amanee haadhaa, warazaqaneehi, min ghayri hawlin minnee walaa quwwah

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُم، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ)).
duas.e: (O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.)
duas.c: A dinner guest's invocation for his host
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 3730 (’Abd Allah b. Busr from Banu Sulaim said:)
duas.t: Allaahumma baarik lahum feemaa razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum

duas.a: ((أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ)).
duas.e: (May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.)
duas.c: Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them
duas.s:
Sunan Ibn Majah 1481 (It was
narrated that ‘Abdullah bin Zubair said:)
duas.t: Aftara 'indakumus saa'imoona, wa akala ta'aamakumul abraaru, wasallat 'alaykumul malaa'ikah

duas.a: ((إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ)).
duas.e: (I am fasting, I am fasting.)
duas.c: What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you
duas.s: Muwatta Malik 713
duas.t: Innee saa'imun, innee saa'im

duas.a: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ)).
duas.e: (May Allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.)
duas.c: Invocation for the groom
duas.s: Sunan ad-Darimi 1459
duas.t: Baarakallaahu lak, wabaaraka 'alayk, wajama'a baynakumaa fee khayr

duas.a: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا)).
duas.e: (In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.)
duas.c: Invocation to be recited before intercourse
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 766 (Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:)
duas.t: Bismillaah, allaahumma jannibnaash shaytaana, wajannibish shaytaana maa razaqtanaa

duas.a: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً)).
duas.e: (All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.)
duas.c: What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune
duas.s: Sunan Ibn Majah 3628 (It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:)
duas.t: Alhamdu lillaahi alladhee 'aafaanee mimmabtalaaka bihi, wafaddalanee 'alaa katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeelan

duas.a: ((أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ)).
duas.e: (May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.)
duas.c: Invocation for someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah
duas.s: Sunan Abi Dawud 5127 (Narrated Anas ibn Malik:)
duas.t: Ahabbaka alladhee ahbabtanee lah

duas.a: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ)).
duas.e: (May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.)
duas.c: Invocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth
duas.s: Sunan an-Nasai 4693 (it was narrated from Isla'il bin Ibrahim bin 'Abdullah bin Abi Rabi'ah, from his father, that his grandfather said:)
duas.t: Baarakallaahu laka fee ahlika wamaalik

duas.a: ((بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ)).
duas.e: (May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.)
duas.c: Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money
duas.s: Sunan an-Nasai 4693 (it was narrated from Isla'il bin Ibrahim bin 'Abdullah bin Abi Rabi'ah, from his father, that his grandfather said:)
duas.t: Baarakallaahu laka fee ahlika wamaalik, innamaa jazaa'us salafil hamdu wal adaa

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّياطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا)).
duas.e: (O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.)
duas.c: Invocation for entering a town or city
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Allaahumma Rabbas samaawaatis sab'i wamaa azlalna, wa Rabbal aradeenas sab'i wamaa aqlalna, wa Rabbash shayaateeni wamaa adlalna, wa Rabbar riyaahi wamaa dharayna, as'aluka khayra haadhihil qaryah, wakhayra ahlihaa, wakhayra maa feehaa, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa, washarri ahlihaa, washarri maa feehaa

duas.a: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاِ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)).
duas.e: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.)
duas.c: Invocation for entering a market
duas.s: Sunan ad-Darimi 1960
duas.t: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul mulku walahul hamdu, yuhyee wayumeetu, wahuwa hayyun laa yamootu, biyadihil khayru, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

duas.a: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ، [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ])).
duas.e: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].
duas.c: What a Muslim should say when he is praised
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Allaahumma laa tu'aakhidhnee bimaa yaqooloona, waghfir lee maa laa ya'lamoona, [waj'alnee khayran mimmaa yazunnoon]

duas.a: ((لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ)).
duas.e: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise and blessings are Yours, and all sovereignty, You have no partner.
duas.c: The pilgrim's announcement of his arrival for Hajj or Umrah
duas.t: Labbayka allaahumma labbayk, labbayka laa shareeka laka labbayk, innal hamda wan ni'mata laka wal mulk, laa shareeka lak.

duas.a: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ!)).
duas.e: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.)
duas.c: What to say when you feel frightened
duas.s: Riyad as-Salihin 239 (Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:)
duas.t: Laa ilaaha illallaah

duas.a: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي)).
duas.e: (In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, (it is) from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.)
duas.c: What to say when slaughtering or sacrificing an animal
duas.s: Hisn al-Muslim
duas.t: Bismillaahi wallaahu akbar. [Allaahumma minka walak.] Allaahumma taqabbal minnee
